heading: Flag officers
lead: During any period in which the Coast Guard is not operating as a service in the Navy, section 1216(d) of title 10 does not apply with respect to flag officers of the Coast Guard.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2018—Pub. L. 115–282 renumbered section 296 of this title as this section.
